# Connectors

The commands `mt help` lists under Connectors. More in [Tools](../../../concepts/tools.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`connector-delete`](#connector-delete) | Delete a connector by name, without asking for `--confirm` (refused while a tool is built on it) |
| [`connector-get`](#connector-get) | Show a connector by name: its type, latest version, authentication, URL and id |
| [`connector-list`](#connector-list) | List the connectors in a namespace (every namespace when none is set) |
| [`connector-version-disable`](#connector-version-disable) | Disable one version of a connector so it is never used again (anything pinned to it fails until you re-enable it or redeploy) |
| [`connector-version-enable`](#connector-version-enable) | Re-enable a disabled version of a connector |

## connector-delete

Delete a connector by name, without asking for `--confirm` (refused while a tool is built on it).

```text
mt connector-delete <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the connector to delete |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

## connector-get

Show a connector by name: its type, latest version, authentication, URL and id.

```text
mt connector-get <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the connector to show |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

## connector-list

List the connectors in a namespace (every namespace when none is set).

```text
mt connector-list [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

## connector-version-disable

Disable one version of a connector so it is never used again (anything pinned to it fails until you re-enable it or redeploy).

```text
mt connector-version-disable <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the connector |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--version, -v <number>` | whole number | yes |  | The version number to disable |

## connector-version-enable

Re-enable a disabled version of a connector.

```text
mt connector-version-enable <name> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<name>` | text | yes |  | Name of the connector |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--version, -v <number>` | whole number | yes |  | The version number to re-enable |
